insurer_name: Royal Sundaram General Insurance Co. Limited
specific_diseases_listed: Stones in Biliary and Urinary systems
Chronic Renal Failure or end stage Renal Failure
Sinusitis/Deviated Nasal Septum/Tympanoplasty/Chronic Suppurative Otitis Media
sub_limits_waiting_notes: 90 days initial waiting for Critical Illness. Bariatric Surgery 72 months (Supreme Plus) / 48 months (Elite Plus). IVF 48 months. PED 24 months for Elite plan only.

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Covered up to Sum Insured. Modern Treatments up to 50% of SI.

day_care_treatments.limit_text: All Day Care Procedures covered up to Sum Insured

domiciliary_treatment.limit_text: Covered up to Sum Insured (3 days minimum continuous treatment)

ayush_coverage.notes: Inpatient treatment under Ayurveda, Yoga, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy

maternity_coverage.limit_text: Rs.2-2.5 lakhs per delivery (up to 2 deliveries) under Elite Plan only
maternity_coverage.notes: 36 months waiting period. Husband and wife both covered under floater.

newborn_coverage.limit_text: Rs.6.25-37.5 lakhs (25% of SI) under Elite Plan only; vaccinations up to Rs.10,000 first year
newborn_coverage.notes: Contingent on Maternity Benefit being availed.

organ_donor_expenses.notes: Excludes pre/post hospitalization and screening expenses of donor.

ambulance_cover.limit_text: Rs.3,000 Classic / Rs.5,000 Supreme / Rs.10,000 Elite per hospitalization

critical_illness_cover.limit_text: International treatment abroad for 11 specified CIs (Elite); Second Opinion for 11 CIs (Supreme/Elite); up to 22 CIs with Supreme Plus/Elite Plus
critical_illness_cover.notes: Airfare up to Rs.3 lakhs. Excludes US/Canada unless opted.

restoration_benefit.limit_text: Re-load of Sum Insured up to Base Sum Insured
restoration_benefit.notes: Available for different illness OR different insured for same illness. Not available for 1st claim.

preventive_health_checkup.notes: Over and above Base Sum Insured for insured 18+.

copayment_trigger_notes: 20% co-payment for treatment of pre-existing conditions covered under Elite Plus Inpatient PED in Life Threatening Conditions

worldwide_emergency_cover.limit_text: 50% of Base SI up to Rs.20 lakhs; deductible USD 2,000 per hospitalization
worldwide_emergency_cover.notes: Elite Plan only. Excludes US and Canada (option to include with additional premium).

permanent_exclusions: Rest Cure, Rehabilitation and Respite Care
Treatments in health hydros, nature cure clinics, spas
Sterility and Infertility (covered as IVF rider only)
notable_exclusions_summary: Lifeline excludes congenital external anomalies, cosmetic surgery, infertility (unless IVF rider opted), self-inflicted injuries, and treatment outside India (except worldwide emergency hospitalization and 11 specified critical illnesses under Elite). Maternity is excluded except under Elite Plan with 36-month waiting period.
claim_process_summary: Cashless via TPA helpline for Network Hospitals; reimbursement claims with submission of documents. Settlement within 15 days from receipt of last document; 2% above bank rate interest payable for delay.
available_riders: Include US and Canada for Worldwide Emergency Hospitalization (Elite only)
Supreme Plus (App-based cab ambulance, Refresh of SI, PED inpatient Life Threatening, Bariatric Surgery, Mobility Devices, additional 11 CI Second Opinion)
Elite Plus (Supreme Plus + International Treatment for 14 CIs, IVF Treatment up to Rs.2.5L)
top_rider_examples: Elite Plus (IVF + 14 CIs + PED Life Threatening)
Supreme Plus (Bariatric + Mobility + Refresh of SI)
